info.title: Quiz API
info.description: REST API for listing, attending, submitting, and administering quizzes. Authenticate with a Laravel Passport Bearer token.

post.description: Authenticate any Quiz user with email and password. Returns a Passport Bearer token.
Logs out the currently authenticated user and invalidates the token.

get.description: Public: pass user_id to list published quizzes for that user's country (worldwide quizzes included). Each item includes is_completed, in_progress_attempt_id, and completed_attempt_id. Admin: send a Passport Bearer token and omit user_id to list all quizzes, including unpublished ones. Each admin item includes is_published. Optional country and is_published filters apply to the admin catalog.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Public user UUID. Required unless authenticated as admin.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Defaults to the user's stored country on the public list.

parameters.name: is_published
parameters.description: Admin catalog only. Filter by published status.

post.description: Admin-only. Assign a quiz to one or more countries; omit countries for a worldwide quiz.

get.description: Returns title, description, questions, and options. Correctness flags are included only for admins.

put.description: Admin-only. Send the full quiz payload, including countries and questions, to replace it.

patch.description: Admin-only. Any omitted field is left unchanged. Sending questions replaces the full question set.

post.description: Learner-only. Scores a full set of answers. If the user has an in-progress attend attempt, remaining answers are applied and that attempt is finalized into the leaderboard. If the user already completed the quiz, the existing attempt is returned and a second attempt is not created.

get.description: Best score per user (then fastest completion time) from completed and expired attempts.

post.summary: Start or resume a quiz attempt
post.description: Learner-only. Creates an in-progress attempt or resumes an existing one. If the user already completed or expired the quiz, that attempt is returned instead of starting a new one (retakes are not allowed). Serves the current question only while in progress.

get.description: Returns progress, remaining quiz/question time, and the current question. Timed-out questions are auto-scored as incorrect.

post.description: Validates the current question, option ownership, and server-side time limits. Completing the last question (or hitting the quiz time limit) finalizes score and time for the submit/leaderboard APIs.

409.description: Attempt is no longer in progress

post.description: Admin-only. Stores a jpeg, png, gif, or webp (max 2 MB) and returns a public URL to attach to a question option.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user (Bearer token required).
Returns a paginated list of users.
Returns a single user by UUID.

is_completed.description: Present on the public customer list

in_progress_attempt_id.description: Present on the public customer list when the user has an unfinished attempt

completed_attempt_id.description: Present on the public customer list when the user already finished the quiz

is_published.description: Present on the admin catalog list

prompt.example: What is the capital of India?
What is the capital of France?

passport.description: Paste the Passport access token from POST /v1/auth/login. Swagger UI sends it as Authorization: Bearer {token}.
